items.title: 36氪首发 | 港中大博士、前大疆工程师创业消费级四足机器人，天使轮获正轩领投数千万元
items.title_zh: 香港中文大学博士、前大疆工程师创办消费级四足机器人公司，天使轮融资近五千万元
items.summary: 深圳光之跃迁科技完成近五千万元天使轮融资，由正轩领投，光点资本、力合资本等跟投。公司由港中大博士、前大疆工程师创立，专注于消费级四足机器人研发，资金将用于产品研发、算法迭代及量产准备。

items.title: 头部人形机器人关节公司半年再获新融资，同创伟业领投数亿元｜硬氪首发
items.title_zh: 头部人形机器人关节公司零差云控半年内再获C++轮数亿元融资，同创伟业领投
items.summary: 零差云控完成C++轮数亿元融资，由同创伟业领投、国泰君安创新投资跟投，老股东华控基金追加投资。资金将用于产能扩张和全球市场布局。公司专注于人形机器人关节技术，半年内连续获得融资。

items.title: Google reportedly beats Apple to TSMC's 2nm chip debut with Tensor G6
items.title_zh: Google Tensor G6 据报将率先采用台积电 2nm 工艺，领先苹果
items.summary: According to industry leaks, Google's next-generation Tensor G6 chip will be the first to adopt TSMC's 2nm process, reportedly beating Apple to the milestone. The chip is expected to power Google's upcoming flagship devices.

items.title: Memory Scarcity, Open Models, and the Restructuring of the AI Industry, 2026-2030
items.title_zh: 内存短缺、开放模型与AI产业重构（2026-2030）：推理经济学、训练成本分化与基础设施偿付能力分析
items.summary: A quantitative scenario analysis by Satoshi Matsuoka (xAI) examines four forces reshaping the AI industry through 2030: DRAM/HBM price surges, frontier-capable open-weight models (GLM-5.2), rapid inference-efficiency gains, and compute resale by Meta and xAI. Training bifurcates into a luxury tier ($18-38B per frontier run) and a mass tier (~$5M via RL/distillation). Scenario probabilities: Rotating Landlord Oligopoly 25%, Commoditization Crash 25%.

items.title: A Sovereign, Open-Source Foundation Model for German and English
items.title_zh: Soofi S 30B-A3B：面向德语和英语的主权开源基础模型发布
items.summary: The Soofi-Team presents Soofi S 30B-A3B, a sovereign open-source Mixture-of-Experts foundation model for German and English. With 30B total parameters and 3B activated, the model represents a significant open-source release targeting European language sovereignty.

items.title: Mach-Mind-4-Flash Technical Report
items.title_zh: Mach-Mind-4-Flash 技术报告：35B MoE 智能体模型发布
items.summary: Mach-Mind-4-Flash is a 35B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts agentic model with 3B activated parameters. The technical report details an agentic LLM designed for tool use and complex reasoning tasks, representing a notable step in agentic AI development.

items.title: 9to5Mac Overtime 072: Apple Watch and the new Siri
items.title_zh: Apple Watch 与新 Siri 体验：iOS 27 带来 Siri 功能增强
items.summary: 9to5Mac discusses new Siri features on Apple Watch with iOS 27, including enhanced messaging, improved Siri experience on the watch, and feature wish list items. The update represents Apple's continued investment in AI-powered assistant capabilities on wearables.

items.title: Ask HN: Add flag for AI-generated articles
items.title_zh: Hacker News 讨论：是否应该添加AI生成文章标记功能
items.summary: A Hacker News user proposes adding an AI-generated content flag that would not de-rank articles but could provide visibility into how much content is AI-generated. The discussion reflects growing community concern about AI-generated material on discussion platforms.

items.title: SpaceX gears up for Starship Flight 13
items.title_zh: SpaceX 准备进行星舰第13次飞行测试
items.summary: SpaceX plans to conduct its next Starship launch as soon as July 16, testing fixes from the previous flight and deploying functioning Starlink satellites. Flight 13 aims to demonstrate improved reliability after addressing issues identified in earlier missions.

items.title: Mercedes AMG CLA 45 arrives in Goodwood with 680 hp and three axial-flux motors
items.title_zh: 奔驰 AMG CLA 45 亮相古德伍德：680匹马力、三台轴向磁通电机
items.summary: Mercedes unveiled the AMG CLA 45 4MATIC+ at the Goodwood Festival of Speed, featuring 680 horsepower and three axial-flux electric motors. The vehicle showcases next-generation EV motor technology with axial-flux design providing higher power density.

items.title: Google reportedly beats Apple to TSMC's 2nm chip debut with Tensor G6
items.title_zh: Google Tensor G6 据报将率先采用台积电 2nm 工艺，领先苹果
items.summary: According to industry leaks, Google's next-generation Tensor G6 chip will be the first to adopt TSMC's 2nm process, reportedly beating Apple to the milestone. The chip is expected to power Google's upcoming flagship devices.

items.title: 对话Om AI赵天成：多年坚守，押注物理AI原生的「流式」未来
items.title_zh: Interview: Om AI's Zhao Tiancheng on Betting on 'Streaming' Physical AI Future
items.summary: Om AI CEO赵天成分享：一个从未看过监控画面的多模态模型却比在监控数据上训练多年的小模型更懂监控，证明了多模态训练为物理开放世界带来的泛化能力。Om AI押注物理AI的流式处理架构，强调与LLM为核心的生成式AI不同的技术路径。

items.title: Paper-Thin Smart Material Adhesion Increased 400x: NPU Discovers Electric-Activated Grip Holding 10-Pound Dumbbells
items.title_zh: 西北工业大学发现电激活智能材料：粘附力增强400倍，可提起10磅哑铃
items.summary: Northwestern Polytechnical University developed a smart adhesive material that activates a 400x stronger grip when electrified. The paper-thin material can hold 10-pound dumbbells, with potential applications in chip manufacturing handling and robotic grippers.

items.title: AI家庭智能硬件公司获数千万元融资，首款产品今年上线海外｜硬氪首发
items.title_zh: AI Home Hardware Startup MOVA LINCO Raises Tens of Millions in Angel Funding, First Product Launching Overseas
items.summary: 威联机器人科技（MOVA LINCO）完成数千万元天使轮融资，资金用于AI算法底层技术研发、量产体系完善及全球化渠道布局。核心团队来自头部网络通信与智能硬件企业，首款AI家庭智能产品计划今年在海外上线。

items.title: 王阳明心学，被Anthropic用来教Claude做人了
items.title_zh: Anthropic Uses Wang Yangming's Philosophy to Teach Claude Ethics
items.summary: 虎嗅报道，硅谷AI公司Anthropic正在招聘哲学家以指导AI模型的对齐训练，其中包括借鉴王阳明心学思想来培养Claude的道德推理能力。哲学家正在成为硅谷AI公司最抢手的人才类型。

items.title: 韩国法院禁止两名前三星员工就职于SK海力士
items.title_zh: South Korean Court Bans Two Former Samsung Employees from Working at SK Hynix
items.summary: 韩国水原地方法院支持三星电子部分诉求，裁定两名前NAND闪存设计员工在2027年4月30日前不得为SK海力士工作，竞业限制期限从三星要求的2年缩短至18个月。案件涉及NAND闪存设计技术保护。

items.title: Major Breakthrough: CZ-10B Threads the Needle for Net Recovery, But What Remains for Private Rockets?
items.title_zh: 长征十号B成功实现网捕回收突破，中国民营火箭面临新挑战
items.summary: CASC's Long March 10B has demonstrated state-owned reusable rocket capability with a successful net recovery. This achievement raises existential questions for China's private rocket companies about their competitive position versus state-owned capabilities in the commercial launch market.

items.title: After CZ-10B, the Next Exam for China Private Commercial Rocket Companies
items.title_zh: 长征十号B之后，中国民营商业火箭公司面对更高竞争门槛
items.summary: With CASC's Long March 10B successfully demonstrating reusable rocket capability, China's private rocket startups face a higher competitive bar requiring larger payload capacities and reusability. The achievement reshapes the commercial space landscape for Chinese private launch providers.

items.title: Memory Scarcity, Open Models, and the Restructuring of the AI Industry, 2026-2030
items.title_zh: 内存短缺、开放模型与AI产业重构（2026-2030）：推理经济学、训练成本分化与基础设施偿付能力分析

Training bifurcates into a luxury tier ($18-38B per frontier run) and a mass tier (~$5M via RL/distillation). Scenario probabilities: Rotating Landlord Oligopoly 25%, Commoditization Crash 25%.

items.title: Seeing is Free, Speaking is Not: Uncovering the True Energy Bottleneck in Edge VLM Inference
items.title_zh: 看是免费的，说不是：揭示边缘VLM推理中的真正能耗瓶颈
items.summary: NVIDIA researchers analyze energy bottlenecks in Vision-Language Model inference at the edge. They find that vision encoding consumes far less energy than text generation ("speaking"), identifying language generation as the primary energy bottleneck for embodied AI applications running VLMs at the edge.

items.title: VEXAIoT: Autonomous IoT Vulnerability EXploitation using AI Agents
items.title_zh: VEXAIoT：基于AI智能体的物联网漏洞自主利用系统
items.summary: Researchers from xAI and collaborators present VEXAIoT, an autonomous system using AI agents to exploit vulnerabilities in IoT devices. The work addresses the inherent security challenges of resource-constrained IoT systems and demonstrates agentic approaches to vulnerability discovery and exploitation.

items.title: All Explanations are Wrong, But Many Are Useful: Exploring the Rashomon Explanation Set with Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 所有解释都是错误的，但许多是有用的：用LLM探索Rashomon解释集
items.summary: Pan Li (xAI) explores the Rashomon explanation set concept with LLMs, acknowledging that machine learning model explanations are always approximations. The paper investigates how LLMs can help navigate multiple valid but different explanations of model behavior for improved interpretability.

items.title: A Sovereign, Open-Source Foundation Model for German and English
items.title_zh: Soofi S 30B-A3B：面向德语和英语的主权开源基础模型发布
items.summary: The Soofi-Team presents Soofi S 30B-A3B, a sovereign open-source Mixture-of-Experts foundation model for German and English. With 30B total parameters and 3B activated, the model represents a significant open-source release targeting European language sovereignty.

items.title: Mach-Mind-4-Flash Technical Report
items.title_zh: Mach-Mind-4-Flash 技术报告：35B MoE 智能体模型发布
items.summary: Mach-Mind-4-Flash is a 35B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts agentic model with 3B activated parameters. The technical report details an agentic LLM designed for tool use and complex reasoning tasks, representing a notable step in agentic AI development.

items.title: LLM for EDA in Front-End Design: Challenges and Opportunities
items.title_zh: LLM在芯片前端设计EDA中的应用：挑战与机遇
items.summary: A survey paper examines how LLMs can be applied to front-end electronic design automation (EDA), covering challenges and opportunities as chip complexity increases. The authors review LLM applications for accelerating chip design workflows from RTL generation to verification.

items.title: ATLAS: Automated HLS for DL-Optimized FPGAs
items.title_zh: ATLAS：面向深度学习优化FPGA的自动化高层次综合工具
items.summary: ATLAS is a fully automated flow from high-level DL model descriptions (PyTorch/Keras) to FPGA hardware with custom DL-optimized hardblocks. Using GEMM as a universal abstraction, it comprises hls4ml-GEMM compiler frontend and a GEMM IP Generator backend, requiring no manual RTL design.

items.title: StreamDQ: Near-Memory Weight DeQuantization in Custom HBM for Scalable AI Inference Acceleration
items.title_zh: StreamDQ：定制HBM中近存储权重量化解量化技术，加速AI推理
items.summary: StreamDQ integrates compact DeQuantization Blocks into HBM base dies for on-the-fly weight dequantization, eliminating GPU-side CUDA-core overhead. The approach achieves up to 7.08x speedup and 90.23% lower energy for mixed-precision GEMM, reducing LLM inference latency by up to 54.68% and improving decode throughput by up to 2.20x.

items.title: OpenLongTail: Generative Scaling of Long-Tail Driving Data
items.title_zh: OpenLongTail：生成式扩展长尾驾驶数据
items.summary: This paper addresses the long-tail data bottleneck in autonomous driving by proposing generative scaling methods. The approach generates synthetic driving scenarios to cover rare but critical edge cases, improving the robustness of driving policies trained on limited real-world data.

items.title: FreyaTTS Technical Report
items.title_zh: FreyaTTS 技术报告：紧凑型免分词器文本转语音模型
items.summary: Freya-TTS is introduced as a compact, tokenizer-free text-to-speech model. The architecture eliminates the need for a separate text tokenizer while maintaining high-quality speech synthesis, making it suitable for resource-constrained deployment scenarios.

items.title: PAC-ACT: Post-training Actor-Critic for Action Chunking Transformers
items.title_zh: PAC-ACT：动作分块Transformer的后训练Actor-Critic方法
items.summary: PAC-ACT addresses precision industrial contact manipulation by applying post-training actor-critic reinforcement learning to Action Chunking Transformers. The approach improves robot policy robustness under pose perturbations and contact-force variations in industrial settings.

items.title: What VGGT Knows About Overlap: Probing Geometric Foundation Models for Co-Visibility
items.title_zh: VGGT对重叠的了解：探究几何基础模型的共可见性
items.summary: Researchers probe geometric foundation models (specifically VGGT) to understand what they learn about co-visibility between image pairs. The work connects to 3D reconstruction and robotic localization challenges by investigating how well foundation models capture spatial relationships between views.

items.title: Who Needs DRAM? We Have Fiber
items.title_zh: 谁还需要DRAM？我们有光纤：数据中心光存储替代方案
items.summary: Proposes Fiber Memory, using optical fiber as active recirculating delay-line memory for immutable LLM weights in hyperscale data centers. Using multi-core fibers and co-packaged optics, the architecture could eliminate redundant weight storage across 10,000 accelerators and reduce weight-delivery energy by over 70% compared to HBM3e.

items.title: Detecting Ladder Logic Bombs in IEC 61131-3 PLC Programs using ESBMC-PLC+
items.title_zh: 使用ESBMC-PLC+检测PLC程序中的梯形逻辑炸弹
items.summary: ESBMC-LLB uses formal verification to detect malicious ladder logic bombs hidden in PLC function blocks. Using k-induction for unbounded proof of bomb-absence, it detected all 30 bombs in the Iacobelli 2024 dataset and 149/150 bombs in the SWaT corpus with zero false positives, recovering each trigger.

items.title: Miter-Aware LUT Mapping: Aligning Structure and Solvability for Efficient Logic Equivalence Checking
items.title_zh: Miter感知的LUT映射：对齐结构与可解性以实现高效逻辑等价性检查
items.summary: Introduces a miter-aware mapping framework for Logic Equivalence Checking (LEC) that constructs LUT-based miters instead of flat netlists. Combining equivalence-preserving mapping, Gaussian-guided XOR modeling, and solver-oriented LUT selection, the method achieves up to 92.1% reduction in SAT solver runtime.

items.title: 4DR360: State Reasoning for Joint 3D Detection and Occupancy Prediction in 4D Radar-Camera Full-Scene Perception
items.title_zh: 4DR360：4D雷达-相机全场景感知中的联合3D检测与占用预测状态推理
items.summary: 4DR360 proposes state reasoning for joint 3D detection and occupancy prediction using 4D radar-camera fusion. The approach targets reliable full-scene perception for autonomous driving by leveraging multi-modal sensor fusion with temporal radar data.

items.title: Scalable Visual Pretraining for Language Intelligence
items.title_zh: 面向语言智能的可扩展视觉预训练
items.summary: This paper explores how scalable visual pretraining can enhance language intelligence in foundation models. The work investigates methods for leveraging large-scale visual data to improve multimodal language understanding and generation capabilities.

items.title: Evolution of Accuracy and Visual-Cognitive Errors in a Decade of Vision-Language AI Models
items.title_zh: 十年视觉-语言AI模型的准确度与视觉认知错误的演进
items.summary: This paper analyzes how vision-language models have evolved over a decade, tracking both accuracy improvements and the persistence of specific visual-cognitive errors. The longitudinal analysis provides insights into which types of visual reasoning VLMs have mastered versus those that remain challenging.

items.title: Agora: Enhancing LLM Agent Reasoning Via Auction-Based Task Allocation
items.title_zh: Agora：通过拍卖式任务分配增强LLM智能体推理
items.summary: Agora proposes auction-based task allocation to coordinate multiple LLM agents for enhanced reasoning. The mechanism dynamically assigns subtasks to specialized agents, improving the overall reasoning capability beyond single-agent approaches.

items.title: Test-Time Scaling for Small VLMs on Multilingual Visual MCQ
items.title_zh: 小视觉语言模型在多语言视觉多选题上的测试时扩展
items.summary: Investigates whether test-time scaling (TTS) techniques that reliably improve reasoning in large language models can transfer to small vision-language models. The study evaluates TTS on multilingual visual multiple-choice question answering tasks.

items.title: Self-Guided Test-Time Training for Long-Context LLMs
items.title_zh: 长文本LLM的自引导测试时训练
items.summary: Proposes self-guided test-time training (TTT) to improve long-context processing in LLMs. The method enables models to adapt at inference time without external supervision, addressing the degradation in performance that often occurs with very long input sequences.

items.title: ALICE: Learning a General-Purpose Pathology Foundation Model from Vision, Vision-Language, and Slide-Level Experts
items.title_zh: ALICE：从视觉、视觉语言和切片级专家学习通用病理学基础模型
items.summary: ALICE is a general-purpose pathology foundation model trained on vision, vision-language, and slide-level expert knowledge. The model targets comprehensive computational pathology capabilities by integrating multiple modalities and expert-level annotations for improved diagnostic support.

items.title: Malaika: Understanding Malware through Tri-Grounded Agentic Reasoning
items.title_zh: Malaika：通过三重锚定智能体推理理解恶意软件
items.summary: Malaika is a multi-agent framework for malware analysis using three grounding mechanisms: domain grounding for behavior hypotheses, semantics grounding for evidence localization, and knowledge grounding for threat attribution. The system improves analysis quality over prior LLM-based malware-analysis frameworks for Android malware.

items.title: SherAgent: Scaling Attack Investigation in the Wild via LLM-Empowered Iterative Query-Filter Backtracking
items.title_zh: SherAgent：通过LLM驱动的迭代查询-过滤回溯扩展实际攻击调查
items.summary: SherAgent is an LLM-empowered automated investigation system for real-world SOC operations at a major Internet corporation. Using iterative query-filter backtracking over provenance graphs, it improves end-to-end investigation success rate by 31.1% over legacy enterprise baselines and 63.7% over SOTA approaches, costing under $0.10 per investigation.

items.title: CRIMP: Compact & Reliable DNN Inference on In-Memory Processing via Crossbar-Aligned Compression and Non-ideality Adaptation
items.title_zh: CRIMP：通过交叉杆对齐压缩和非理想性适配实现紧凑可靠的存内计算DNN推理
items.summary: CRIMP addresses three obstacles in crossbar-based in-memory processing accelerators: floating-point incompatibility, redundant DNN parameters, and device non-ideality. The unified training framework produces integer-only, pruned, and reliable models with minimal accuracy drops (2.19% for VGG-16, 1.26% for ResNet-56 on CIFAR-10).
